info.title: Omni Connect API
info.description: Interactive reference for the current TypeScript/PostgreSQL application. Dashboard routes use your existing session cookie; /api/v1 routes require an account-scoped Bearer API key. Requests run against this instance: writes, Meta sends and AI calls have real effects. Webhook/cron integrations are reference-only in the browser explorer. Common Better Auth routes are documented explicitly; the library also owns additional generated endpoints. No server credentials are included.
